confidence_notes: Food and drink are anchored on aggregator figures seen in search-result summaries (Numbeo- and Expatistan-type data: inexpensive meal about S/15-17, mid-range dinner for two about S/115-120, domestic beer about S/9-10, cappuccino about S/11-14). I converted them at roughly 3.3-3.4 PEN/USD, as implied by those pages' own USD/PEN conversions, and added a small uplift for tourist districts. These figures are crowd-sourced and vary by neighbourhood. I found no aggregated cocktail or wine-by-the-glass price, only one upscale Miraflores bar averaging about US$11 per cocktail. Cocktail and wine are therefore set at about 2.3x and 2x domestic beer, plus general knowledge of Lima menus. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for Miraflores/Barranco-style tourist areas, not from live listings, and are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Lima's own aggregated price indexes were used for food and drink. Accommodation is judged from general knowledge of Lima's Miraflores and Barranco tourist districts and broadly similar mid-cost Latin American capitals such as Bogota. No comparable-city prices were searched.
